# WazeApp

> WazeApp is an AI-powered WhatsApp automation platform that enables businesses to create intelligent chatbot agents for customer support, sales, and engagement on WhatsApp.

## What WazeApp Does

WazeApp transforms WhatsApp into an AI-powered customer engagement platform. Businesses can:

- Create AI agents that respond to WhatsApp messages 24/7
- Build knowledge bases from documents (PDF, text, URLs) for accurate AI responses
- Support 95+ languages with automatic detection
- Handle voice messages, images, and rich media
- Escalate conversations to human operators when needed
- Send broadcast campaigns to multiple contacts
- Manage an e-commerce catalog and take orders via WhatsApp
- Track analytics on agent performance and customer satisfaction

## Key Features

- **AI Agents**: Configure custom AI personalities with system prompts, tone, and language settings
- **Knowledge Base**: Upload documents to train your agent with domain-specific knowledge using vector search
- **Multi-Provider AI**: Supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, and local models via Ollama
- **Human Escalation**: Automatic handoff to human operators with keyword triggers
- **Broadcast**: Send templated messages to contact lists
- **E-commerce**: Product catalogs, order management, appointment scheduling via WhatsApp
- **Analytics**: Real-time dashboards for message volume, response times, and satisfaction
- **Team Collaboration**: Multi-user organizations with role-based access

## Plans

- **Standard**: 1 AI agent, 500 messages/month, 1 WhatsApp session
- **Pro**: 3 AI agents, 5,000 messages/month, 3 WhatsApp sessions, escalation, e-commerce
- **Enterprise**: 10 AI agents, unlimited messages, 10 WhatsApp sessions, priority support
